name: Peeled & Steamed Yellow Summer Squash
whyItWorks: Yellow summer squash has a delicate, naturally sweet flavor and silky pulp. When peeled and steamed, it breaks down into a soft, non-abrasive vegetable side that provides hydration, potassium, and vitamin C.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel away yellow exterior skin, slice into thin half-moons, and steam or microwave with 2 tablespoons of water until completely soft and tender.
watchOuts: Discard oversized squashes with large, hard mature seeds.
